charts.dailyTrendsSub: Enrollment per period, against the daily enrollment targets
charts.cumulativeTrendsSub: Running totals since the first enrollment, against the target pace
charts.positivityTrendsSub: Cumulative cases as a share of cumulative enrolled participants
charts.enrollmentTrendsBySiteSubCumulative: Cumulative count per site (enrolled shows the per-site target pace)
charts.enrollmentTrendsBySiteSubPositivity: Cumulative cases as a share of cumulative enrolled, per site
charts.enrollmentByFacilitySub: Enrolled, cases and controls per facility
charts.enrollmentTrendsBySiteSub: Enrolled, cases and controls over time — one line per site
charts.enrollmentTrendsBySiteSubGrid: Cases and controls stacked over time — one chart per site; bar height is total enrolled
charts.enrollmentTrendsBySiteSubGridCases: Cases over time — one chart per site
charts.enrollmentTrendsBySiteSubStacked: Enrolled, cases and controls over time — stacked by site
charts.enrollmentByVillageSub: Enrolled, cases and controls per village
charts.coverageByAgeSub: Share of enrolled participants with at least one dose, in 2-month age bins

microscopy.title: Microscopy results
microscopy.noDataHint: Blood-smear reading data has not been loaded. This section will populate automatically once it is available.

verification.title: Vaccine-coverage verification visits
verification.intro: Participants flagged as needing a separate vaccine-coverage visit (need_vac_cov = 1) and how many have a matching vaccine-coverage record.
verification.participantsIntro: Everyone flagged for a vaccine-coverage visit. Where the reason is "Other", the interviewer's own words are shown — clinic staff can turn the visit off if it isn't needed, and that decision is recorded.
verification.search: Search subject ID, barcode, facility or reason

dataQuality.title: Data quality
dataQuality.intro: Automated checks derived from the survey validation rules. Issues re-open if they recur and resolve automatically once the data is corrected.
dataQuality.subject: Subject
dataQuality.auditIntro: Full audit trail of every dismiss and reopen action, with who made the change and when.

map.title: Site progress
map.subtitle: Cumulative enrollment against a 4/day per-site target
map.noCoordinatesHint: Run the facility coordinate seed in Supabase to show sites on the map.

download.title: Download data
download.intro: Export the currently visible records as CSV. Exports respect your country access.
